description:
DUVENBECK LOGISTIK SRL provides complex logistics services (local and international transport of goods, warehousing and other related services), with a presence in Romania for over 16 years .

We want to offer you the opportunity for a professional development in a high-performance and dinamic work environment.


Responsabilities:

  • Takes part in the preparation of the budgets/estimates. Monitors realization and identifies deviations, investigates causes and assesses impact on the company’s performance;
  • Monitors various KPIs, suggests improvements and evaluates possible risks in achieving the company’s financial targets;
  • Prepares regular and ad-hoc management reporting on the company’s financial and operational performance, participates in the continuous improvement of the reporting process;
  • Monitors and intervenes when necessary to ensure the highest level of data quality in all of the company’s databases.

 

 Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration,
  • Minimum 4 years’ experience in controlling/financial analysis (experience in accounting and/or audit is a plus),
  • Strong knowledge of accounting rules and principles,
  • Very good Microsoft Office skills, with an emphasis on strong Excel skills,
  • Experience in SAP/similar ERP required,
  • Advanced English: capable of carrying out a written or verbal conversation regarding daily business, reporting KPI’s, making presentations, presenting and sustaining a professional opinion (German is a plus),
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills to evaluate alternatives and provide recommendations on business issues,
  • Ability to work in a dynamic fast paced environment with tight deadlines,
  • Ability to work both in a team and individually,
  • Good communication skills.
